steps.title: Initialize Project Structure
steps.description: Create the basic project files: index.html, style.css, and script.js.

steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Set up app-meta.json with the application's name and project type.

steps.title: Configure API Schema
steps.description: Define the backend API schema, indicating no backend is required for this simple app.

steps.title: Setup HTML Document
steps.description: Create the basic HTML5 structure in index.html, including title and body.

steps.title: Integrate Tailwind CSS
steps.description: Add the Tailwind CSS CDN link to the HTML head for utility-first styling.

steps.title: Link Custom Stylesheet
steps.description: Link style.css to index.html, although minimal custom CSS will be used for this app.

steps.title: Link JavaScript File
steps.description: Include script.js at the end of the HTML body for any future interactivity.

steps.title: Add Welcome Content
steps.description: Insert a main div containing an h1 element with the 'Welcome' text into index.html.

steps.title: Center Welcome Message
steps.description: Apply Tailwind CSS classes to center the 'Welcome' message vertically and horizontally on the page.

steps.title: Style Welcome Message
steps.description: Add basic text styling using Tailwind CSS, such as font size and color.

steps.title: Finalize Custom CSS
steps.description: Ensure style.css is clean and ready for any additional minor adjustments if needed, though Tailwind handles most styling.

steps.title: Review JavaScript File
steps.description: Confirm script.js is empty as no interactive functionality is required for this welcome app.

steps.title: Building welcomeapp
steps.description: The 'welcomeapp' project has been successfully generated with a basic welcome message.
